description: This file defines the EntityMethod class which implements a Drupal plugin for applying configuration actions to entities by invoking specified methods. It handles method invocation with support for multiple parameters and array unpacking, and is used to convert annotated config entity methods into configurable actions within Drupal.

classes.name: EntityMethod
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that converts config entity methods with the ActionMethod attribute into configurable actions, supporting method invocation with multiple parameters and array unpacking.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the plugin, retrieving the config manager from the container and passing constructor arguments.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the configured method to the specified config entity, handling pluralized or single application based on the plugin configuration.

methods.name: applyPluralized
methods.description: Invokes the method multiple times with each value in an array, throwing an exception if the value is not an array.

methods.name: applySingle
methods.description: Invokes the method once with a single value, supporting array unpacking if multiple parameters are expected.
